description: This file defines the CurlFactory class, which implements a factory for creating and managing cURL handles for HTTP requests within the Guzzle HTTP client library. It includes methods for creating, releasing, and finishing cURL transactions, and handles the configuration of cURL options based on request parameters.

classes.name: CurlFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating and managing cURL handles in Guzzle, encapsulating cURL options setup, handle pooling, and transaction finishing logic.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures a new EasyHandle cURL resource based on the provided request and options.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a handle back to the internal cache or closes it if the cache is full.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes a cURL transaction, returning a fulfilled or rejected promise based on success or failure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CurlFactory with a maximum number of handles to keep in cache.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up all cached handles by closing them when the factory is destroyed.
